d: All classes by category.
Download the Foundry archive, copy the classes you need into your project and load them with require_once, an SPL autoloader or Composer PSR-4.
How Foundry classes are called, which exceptions they throw, how error messages are written, and when to catch them.
The few lines to run once in your entry point - environment, logging, error handling, security headers and sessions.
The rules every Foundry class follows - explicit errors, one file per tool, pure native PHP, no personal data in error messages - and what is deliberately left out.
Foundry is written for PHP 8.3+ and can be downgraded automatically to PHP 7.4. Here is how the two targets relate and how they differ.
